strategy.name: nasdaq100_single_security_strategy1_90_gate_attribution
strategy.description: 复用父实验已冻结的逐证券Strategy1收盘后股票仓位分数和时点成员资格，对354只曾严格超过90%的历史Nasdaq-100证券分别建立独立的全仓或现金账户。某证券当日收盘分数严格高于90%时，下一可成交交易日Open全仓买入；分数不再严格高于90%时，下一可成交交易日Open全部卖出。报告逐证券的日历CAGR、按持仓时间几何压缩的持仓期间CAGR、持仓收益Sharpe、最大回撤、持仓时间、持仓段数，以及卖出后5/10/20/60个交易日的表现，用于判断90%门槛是否经常在反弹前退出。历史成分和个股行情仍是pending_review候选数据，因此只作探索性归因。
strategy.buy_rule: 对每个稳定security_id独立判断：若上一交易日已完成Close后的Strategy1股票仓位严格大于0.90，且该日已经按一交易日滞后的时点成员口径合格，则在本交易日有效Open把该证券账户从现金切换为100%股票。临时缺少真实信号栏或真实执行栏时冻结原仓位；禁止在合成carry栏买入。
strategy.sell_rule: 若上一交易日不在严格大于0.90的合格分数表中且该信号日有真实行情，则在本交易日有效Open把已有股票全部卖出。历史证券最后一个真实行情日后的首个终止结算代理Open只允许卖出；此后不允许买入。
strategy.signal_time: 复用父run在每个XNYS交易日完成后的拆股及股息调整Close、Strategy1收盘后仓位分数和滞后一交易日的历史成分状态；没有重算StochRSI或修改资格。
strategy.execution_time: 收盘信号在下一XNYS交易日的拆股及股息调整Open成交；分别按单边0和5bps不利冲击，允许小数股。
strategy.positioning: 每只证券是互相独立的10万美元虚拟账户，只能处于100%该证券或100%现金，不融资、不做空、现金不计息；结果不是把354只同时组成一个真实组合。

plain_language.summary: 逐只检查Strategy1仓位超过90%时持有该股票，是否真的抓住了高质量上涨区间。
plain_language.buy: 某只股票的Strategy1仓位在收盘后超过90%时，下一交易日开盘把它自己的虚拟账户全部买入该股票。
plain_language.sell: 这只股票的Strategy1仓位不再超过90%时，下一交易日开盘把它自己的虚拟账户全部转回现金。
plain_language.execution: 信号只在收盘后确认，订单在下一交易日开盘成交；缺少真实行情时先保持原仓位，不能在补齐价格上买入。
plain_language.position: 每只股票单独使用一笔固定本金，只在全仓该股和全现金之间切换，不把这些单股账户合并成组合。

parameters.score_definition: post-trade Strategy1 equity weight in the security at completed Close
parameters.membership_definition: parent run's point-in-time Nasdaq-100 membership observed with one XNYS-session lag
parameters.temporary_unavailability_policy: change position only when the prior signal session and intended execution session have real vendor bars; otherwise freeze and reconsider on the next consecutive real signal/execution pair
parameters.terminal_price_policy: the first terminal settlement proxy after the last real vendor bar may execute a sell only; it can never execute a buy
parameters.holding_time_definition: percentage of analysis sessions whose Close ends with positive shares
parameters.holding_period_cagr_definition: geometrically compress calendar CAGR by the Close-position holding-time fraction, matching the existing Strategy1 gate definition; for example 10% calendar CAGR at 50% holding time becomes 21%
parameters.holding_sharpe_definition: annualized zero-risk-free Sharpe over the returns actually earned while exposed, including entry Open-to-Close, continuing Close-to-Close and exit prior-Close-to-Open components
parameters.max_drawdown_definition: maximum peak-to-trough drawdown of the single-security gated account, whose cash intervals are flat
parameters.post_exit_return_definition: from the actual sell fill to the adjusted Close N XNYS sessions later when that horizon has a real vendor bar
parameters.post_exit_max_rebound_definition: highest adjusted High in the next N XNYS sessions relative to the actual sell fill, using real vendor bars only

benchmark: No common portfolio benchmark is used for the requested per-security attribution; each row is the same security's Strategy1 >90% gate under 0/5bps, with calendar metrics retained beside holding-only metrics.

reporting.reuse_review: Reuse v5 and the parent run's frozen score/price cache; add a sortable 354-security attribution table, holding-quality scatter and post-exit rebound diagnostics without rerunning Strategy1 or the 16 portfolio paths.

research.hypothesis: The strict Strategy1 >90% gate may identify strong rising intervals but exit individual constituents before a rebound. Per-security holding-only CAGR, Sharpe, drawdown and post-exit forward returns can distinguish weak trend capture from premature exit without changing the strategy.
research.primary_metric: At zero cost, inspect the cross-sectional distribution of holding-period CAGR, holding-return Sharpe and maximum drawdown among securities with at least 252 holding sessions; separately summarize actual exits followed by positive 5/10/20/60-session returns. Retain 5bps as a friction sensitivity and report all securities regardless of sample size.
research.selection_rule: Do not select or tune a new threshold. Freeze the parent run's strict 90% eligibility rows, point-in-time membership lag, next-Open timing and missing-bar policies; publish the full per-security table and label small holding/exit samples rather than dropping them.
research.validation_plan: Hash and copy the parent validated shared artifacts, test strict threshold timing, next-Open entry/exit, missing-bar freeze, terminal sell-only behavior, geometric holding CAGR and post-exit horizons. For every security/cost path reconcile the daily account equity against the independently compounded exposed-return components within 1e-6, then run report, Chrome, PDF, catalog, workspace and validate_run gates.
research.promotion_criteria: This diagnostic does not promote a strategy. It may justify a separately frozen exit-rule experiment only if the premature-exit pattern is broad across securities with adequate holding and exit samples, remains directionally similar at 5bps, and survives approved data plus a predeclared forward or walk-forward test.
research.rejection_conditions: Reject any claim based on current constituents, same-Close fills, threshold greater-than-or-equal semantics, recomputed or altered parent scores, hidden small samples, synthetic-bar buys, unreported terminal sells, post-exit horizons without real prices, non-finite ledgers, reconciliation error above 1e-6, or language treating pending_review candidate data as formal evidence.
